blocks.x: Traveling can be a noisy affair—from crying babies on airplanes to busy main streets with honking cars that drive past your hotel room at 3 a.m. While the noises of a new city can certainly be worth experiencing (whether that be actual music rooted in a specific location or the ambient sounds of church bells and passing trolleys), not all sounds are made the same. To help you block out any unnecessary background noise and get a good night’s sleep—or simply a moment of peace and quiet—Loop earplugs come in handy. Nothing will run you down quite as quickly while on vacation as poor sleep and no relaxation.

As a personal favorite earplug of mine, I can attest that Loops are the ideal travel companion, whether that be for getting some shut-eye on the plane, helping you focus on remote work in a crowded coffee shop, or protecting your eardrums at a club in Lisbon. Read on to see how you can save money on a pair for yourself with Loop Earplugs discount codes.
10% off your first order with this Loop Earplugs discount code

New Loop shoppers will be thrilled to hear that you can easily save on your very first order. When you sign up for the brand’s free newsletter, you’ll receive an exclusive Loop Earplugs promo code for 10% off your first order—the single-use coupon is sent directly to your email.

Loop has nine different styles depending on your needs, ranging from a heavier-duty noise-dampening experience ideal for a night of deep sleep to the perfect buds to protect your ears during a concert or music festival. The products range slightly in style and how much noise they filter so you can create a personalized experience to match your needs.
Save 20% with Loop earplug bundles without a coupon code

If, like me, you were waffling between a few different pairs for different situations, why not bundle them to save as much as possible? Snagging one of the Loop earplug bundles helps you save up to 20% off or $32 on styles compared to the prices of individual products when sold separately. If you’re a big traveler (like I am), consider the Travel bundle, which includes both the Loop Dream earplugs (with ultra-soft tips, it’s great for keeping the noise out while you sleep—even snoring travel companions and nearby highway traffic) and the Loop Switch 2 earplugs (featuring three noise-cancelling modes to take you from the airport to the hotel lobby and beyond). They throw in a plush, light-blocking eye mask as well.

For those who need ultimate quiet, I recommend the Daily Calm bundle, which saves you 15% and includes the Dream earplugs as well as the Engage 2 Plus earplugs (a unique design that features a mute button that can block out even more sounds on demand). If you want to save on Loop’s top three bestsellers—perfect for sleep, live concert experiences, or everyday noise-blocking capabilities—I suggest the Earplug bundle, at $14 off compared to buying separately, with shipping included.
Join the Loop Earplugs Circle for exclusive benefits & discounts

Once you’ve signed up and gotten a deal on your first pair, it’s time to become a true Loop Earplugs member (and save even more). Members start immediately earning points and are able to unlock members-only rewards on every online purchase. To become a member, simply create a Loop account on their site and reap the benefits. You’ll get five points for each dollar you spend on Loop products on the online store, so really, it pays to try out as many styles as you want. Once you start earning points you’ll be able to redeem them for exclusive rewards. You can also earn points in other ways aside from purchasing online: You’ll get 250 on your birthday, 100 when you leave a review, and 25 if you subscribe to their YouTube channel, just to name a few. There are four tiers of membership—each with its own respective perks—based on the number of points you have. For example, by 2,000 points you’ll reach the “Innovator” level, and get a free set of Loop Quiet earplugs in addition to the benefits you receive from the first two tiers.

Members can also gain access to the Archive Sale, for which they’ll be alerted to any future dates of when they join Loop Circle. Archive Sales offer members access to limited edition pieces and specific colorways.
Get 15% off + 150 points using your Loop referral code

Once you fall in love with your Loops—and how protected your peace (and eardrums) feel—you can start getting your friends in on the goods. One of the great rewards members receive is the ability to earn points by referring their friends. Use your Loop referral code to get 150 points credited to your Loop Rewards account and earn them a 15% discount on their first order. Make sure your next group trip goes off without a hitch by guaranteeing a good night’s sleep for all and an easy way to block out the noise whenever anyone needs to rest—without killing the party for the rest of the squad.
20% off Loop earplugs for students, teachers, military, and first responders

There are even more ways to save on your favorite earplugs. If you are a student or teacher, verify your status with SheerID through the links above to get 16% to 20% off earplugs and accessories. For eligible active first responders, medical workers, and armed forces members, verify your status with SheerID to secure a 20% discount on all your favorite Loop products.
Free shipping on orders over $44

Unlike most stores, the price point for free shipping at Loops is fairly low, so there’s no reason not to meet the $44 threshold. Many of the more advanced Loop earplugs already meet the threshold on their own, but for those that don’t, consider bundling them with another pair, or snagging an accessory while you shop, like a Loop Link (to keep your earbuds physically connected while in use), or an extra carry case if you travel a lot.
When to find the best Loop coupon codes

While the above codes are active year-round as of now, you can mark your calendar with special promo periods and dates to ensure that you have the best savings possible. Key times like Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and Labor Day will usually offer even more ways to save, so keep your eyes open for additional discounts and rewards. The brand also creates seasonal special edition models for upcoming events or in collaboration with their team, like Coachella or the McLaren F1 team, so you can attend your favorite experiences in style—and protect your hearing while you do so.
What to do when your Loop promo code isn’t working

Trying to check out and your Loop promo code isn’t working? There are a few things to do to make sure you don’t lose out on your discounts. First, make sure that you’re typing in your promo code correctly. Pay special attention to things like letters that look like numbers, incorrect spacing, and capitalization. If all seems to be in order, take a look at the fine print. Is there a minimum spend limit that you didn’t meet? Has the expiration date passed? Are you trying to apply the coupon to a product that is excluded from the promo?

The next thing you can do is rule out any hardware or software issues by switching browsers, clearing your cookies or cache, or switching to a new device altogether. If all else fails, consider reaching out to the Loop Earplugs team for more personalized help.
